Story:
Yuri calls Spider-Man after Silver Sable recovers Morgan Michaels, letting him know they have located a vehicle that matches that of the one Martin Li took after stealing the Devil's Breath with his Inner Demons.
As Spider-Man heads there, Dr. Michaels, using one of Sable's radios, calls Spider-Man to inform him that transit hubs are the most likely release for Devil's Breath, and how he regrets ignoring the risks Devil's Breath posed while he worked on it. When Spider-Man arrives at Yuri's location, he finds the car empty. He also cannot reach Mary Jane Watson to warn her about the Devil's Breath.
Meanwhile, Mary Jane is at Grand Central Station, where several advertisements for Oscorp technology are present. As she views an advertisement for the Gaia Microbe Dispersal Device, Martin Li arrives behind her, and he and his Demons take control of the station. Li calls Norman Osborn to order him to come to Grand Central Terminal alone in thirty minutes or he will kill more people.
Mary Jane is forced into the center with the others, but manages to reach Spider-Man for help. Spider-Man deduces that Li's plan is to force Osborn to release Devil's Breath himself, making him responsible. Spider-Man enters, but drones patrolling make him unable to act.
When Mary Jane works with him in order to steal the control tablet for the drones, she is interrupted when one of the prisoners decides to attack the Demons. With no other recourse, she reveals herself as a reporter, insisting she can assure Osborn arrives on time so long as they do not kill the prisoner. When they agree, she leads one of the them to another part of the building, where Spider-Man attacks and webs him up.
After Mary Jane disables the drones using the tablet, Spider-Man and Mary Jane work together. They have a difference of opinion on their partnership, where Spider-Man urges her to leave and promises to return for Devil's Breath later, but Mary Jane refuses due to the people in danger. With Spider-Man's help, Mary Jane is able to get back to the bomb to diffuse it.
Once diffused, Spider-Man takes out more of the Demons stealthily. When enough have been disabled, Spider-Man gives the all-clear for the hostages to flee, and Mary Jane leads them to safety. Martin Li ends up being in one of the subway cars below, and Spider-Man follows him and battles him in a subway car. Spider-Man apprehends Li and stops the runaway subway train, with Li sent to the Raft. Afterward, awkward texts with Mary Jane, who is not yet ready to talk on the phone, suggest she might be considering their relationship over, though she suggests she may call him the next day. Yuri calls Spider-Man to congratulate him as Li is sent to the Raft while Devil's Breath is secured by Sable.
Walkthrough:
Upon reaching the mission location, players assume the perspective of Mary Jane, entering Grand Central Station. They are free to roam about examining the various advertisements for Oscorp technology, but the one that triggers the next part is the Gaia Microbe Dispersal Device.
After a cutscene, as Mary Jane, players must move the camera around the room to point out points of danger for Spider-Man. When asked to find an entry point for him, the vent is in the southwest corner, right behind Mary Jane's right shoulder.
Spider-Man arrives, but players still assume Mary Jane's role, watching as he sneaks his way inside. After he causes a distraction, run for the control tablet to commence a brief cutscene, and after this, follow the waypoint to another part of the room so Spider-Man can web up the Demon led astray. After the next cutscene, a stealth segment commences.
The stealth segment is similar to usual Mary Jane segments with the exception that players can call Spider-Man to help eliminate some guards. Using lures, players can throw lures to separate Demons apart so that Spider-Man can be called to web and eliminate them. Not all Demons have to be eliminated, and Mary Jane simply needs to approach the group near the Devil's Breath bomb then cause a distraction.
After reaching the bomb, a cutscene commences, following which players have to diffuse it. This is done by tracing the wires to their source on the device, rotating to follow them, then pulling the wires: the two blue wires first, the yellow next, and the red wire last.
Players then assume the role of Spider-Man, waiting above. This is another stealth mission, tasking players with taking high points and then stringing up the Inner Demons from above. A cutscene commences after this, at which point an all-out battle commences.
Martin Li ends up being in one of the subway cars below, and players quickly board in order to fight him. As it is a subway car, it is a very close-quarters combat fight, and players will find they have nowhere to swing off to. Webbing Li works, and players must be very quick to use their dodge when their Spider-Sense goes off. The fight is more difficult in the second car, as players need to continually dodge side to side and at a distance to avoid his amped-up blasts. Players will also begin to have to jump onto the ceiling. Spider-Man will announce when the best time to strike is, so players should hold off until they hear the message.
After successfully defeating Li, players will have to stop the runaway subway car by paying attention to the screen prompts. A cutscene then ends the mission, and player shave time to roam the city as Spider-Man and complete citywide activities. When Otto Octavius calls, the mission "Breakthrough" is available.

Story:
Once Peter arrives, he finds that the Doctor has already utilized an intra-cranial neural network to attach and use his prosthetic arms, giving him neuro-transmission speeds under one nanosecond, faster than signals traveling inside the brain.
When Peter examines the interface, he notices there are errors with cascading voltage spikes in the motor complex, doubting if he can fix it. The interface gives a 38.7% probability of seizures, 40.4% probability of short-term memory loss, and 62.3% probability of long-term memory loss. Peter than expresses concerns that the neural web was not isolating his motor neurons and that Otto has not tested it enough. This angers Otto, who says he "does not feel like a failure" for the first time in his life, before Otto calms down after Peter reminds him he is not a failure and promises that they are close.
Otto thanks Peter as he leaves, before the news report comes on in which Norman Osborn claims credit for the apprehension of Martin Li. Otto smashes the television with one of his robotic arms in rage.
Walkthrough:
After reaching the lab and after a cutscene, players will be tasked with completing a trio of circuit puzzles to set things right. Regardless of the success in these projects, the outcome will be the same. Once the cutscene ends, the next mission, "Reflection", is available.

Story:
When Peter calls Miles to check up on him, Miles responds that though he wanted to quit at first, he was reminded of his father's words, "a hero's just a guy who doesn't give up", and realized that nothing Martin Li did was the fault of anyone at the shelter. Peter tells Miles he is proud of him, and then travels to the center to check up on Miles in person. On the way, Parker calls Yuriko Watanabe to congratulate her promotion to captain and suggest she take a vacation, something she declines.
There, Peter speaks to Aunt May. After shrugging off Peter's concerns that May was overworking herself, she tells Peter that the Martin Li she knew could not have committed terrorist attacks and did not want to remember him that way. She also urges Peter to be honest with Mary Jane Watson to improve their difficult relationship. Their conversation is interrupted with a news report that the truck carrying the vial of Devil's Breath was attacked. By the time Aunt May has turned around, Peter has already vanished.
Walkthrough:
The mission simply comprises a cutscene as the player reaches the shelter. After the cutscene ends, the lengthy mission "Out of the Frying Pan..." is available.

Story:
After Spider-Man arrives at the Sable International truck, Yuriko Watanabe meets him there via helicopter to reveal the situation is much worse, pointing to the Ryker's Island attack. Spider-Man hitches a ride with her and defeats many of the prisoners there, preventing them from stealing a chopper.
Spider-Man hitches a ride with Yuri to the Raft, and when they arrive, Electro appears and shoots their helicopter with a bolt of electricity. Spider-Man barely holds on. He grabs hold of Yuri and brings the helicopter into a somewhat controlled crash. Electro then uses his powers to open the cell blocks.
Once the prisoners are largely subdued, Spider-Man begins his pursuit of Electro outside. This is briefly interrupted by Vulture. Spider-Man chases Electro out on the roof, where he is then surrounded by Vulture, Rhino, Scorpion, and Mister Negative. The fight is fierce, but they gain the upper hand. As Spider-Man crawls to the edge of the building, none other than Otto Octavius arrives, having taken on the mantle of Doctor Octopus. He warns Spider-Man not to interfere before throwing him over the edge.
The villains then disperse, having particular jobs to do that will erase any debt they owe to Doctor Octopus.
Walkthrough:
Following a cutscene, as Spider-Man, players help in minimizing the damage at Ryker's, even stopping the prisoners from escaping in a helicopter. A lengthy battle occurs against freed prisoners. These are functionally identical to previous enemies fought, particularly Wilson Fisk's thugs, and some are armed with rocket launchers. Web Bombs are effective due to the enclosed spaces.
After defeating most around the prison, a few will arrive attacking a police car; these must be taken out to proceed. Prisoners then attempt to steal a chopper. Follow on-screen prompts to save it, and a cutscene leads to the next section. Inside the Raft, more prisoners are fought. Players must proceed through the Raft, defeating prisoners, with a few cutscenes along the way.
Eventually, Spider-Man catches up to and pursues Electro. Much of the pursuit is dependent upon players' ability to dodge Electro's attacks, especially when the chase goes up a long shaft. The lengthy chase around the Raft culminates in a cutscene ending the mission.
After the mission, the main mission, Quarantine, will automatically begin.

Story:
Yuri calls Spider-Man requesting urgent help for her officers. She then requests Spider-Man take out either Rhino or Electro. On the way there, Aunt May calls to tell Spider-Man that men from Ryker's are at the F.E.A.S.T.'s sister office, the Veteran's Center, ransacking it and demanding supplies.
After dealing with the precincts, a panicked Mary Jane Watson calls and says it is urgent Spider-Man get to the Veteran's Center. The convicts set the building ablaze, trapping Miles Morales and Aunt May inside.
Inside, Spider-Man finds Miles and May trapped on a collapsing floor, using his webbing to hold it in place. He cannot quite make it to the open window, but Mary Jane appears, coming inside to push against a beam that falls, closing the gap. Aunt May manages to get to safety, but not Miles as the floor shifts. Spider-Man's webbing unlatches just as Miles jumps, and Mary Jane helps him to her side. Just then, the floor above collapses onto Spider-Man. He manages to get off a shot, but it does not stick to anything. Miles manages to grab it, and then he and Mary Jane pull Spider-Man to safety.
After, Mary Jane and Spider-Man reconcile. Mary Jane says she is happy to have rescued him, as it is hard for her to always be the one to be saved. Spider-Man enlists both Mary Jane and Miles for aid: Mary Jane to track down an antidote for the Devil's Breath and Miles to keep an eye and ear open at F.E.A.S.T.
Walkthrough:
Players are initially free to engage criminals and soldiers alike until Yuri calls, at which point the mission can begin. Players have a choice to engage Electro or Rhino first, where they protect the police precincts to turn the tide in favor of the police.
Electro[]
When arriving at this precinct, Electro launches his electricity into the building in order to electrify the structure and overload the transformers before fleeing. Inner Demons are in a helicopter firing rockets and also on the roof itself.
Players need to destroy the transforms using their Web Shooter. There are five in the area total on the rooftops, including one towed in mid-air by the helicopter, all guarded by Demons. If players are quick enough, they can use their Shooters in mid-air and not have to worry about engaging the Demons.
Once free from the electricity, the police are able to exit the building in order to engage with the Demons. Players still need to defeat the Demons at ground level before proceeding.
Rhino[]
Upon arrival, Rhino has smashed his way through most of the police vehicles, leaving the way open for the Ryker's Island convicts to attempt a push through the barricades. Players need to assist the police in stopping the convicts across rooftops before they can do so. The weapons the prisoners use include stun batons, explosives, riot shields, machine guns, and Molotov cocktails. There is plenty of debris for players to pick up and sling at them. At one of the barricades a prisoner from the Raft wields two flaming whips, so players should be cautious.
There are three barricades total that players must protect before they need to head roof-side to deal with convicts using RPGs. There are four rooftops total that need to be cleared, and the fights are straightforward.
The situation becomes more difficult when Sable troops arrive via jetpack and target Spider-Man. In order to counter them, in addition to dodging their attacks, players need to Web Strike (tap ) to get close where they can be fought with melee attacks. Debris can also be thrown at them.
Veteran's Center[]
Once both Rhino and Electro are dealt with, a call from Mary Jane leads to the next objective, the Veteran's Center. Upon reaching it, a cutscene closes out the mission, and the next, "Picking up the Trail", is available.

Story:
Yuri calls Spider-Man to let him know the department cannot do a forensics sweep of Times Square because everyone is sick. There, Spider-Man follows a dispersal trial into Doctor Octopus's lair.
At the lair, Spider-Man uncovers more of Otto's hatred for Norman Osborn and the origins of the Sinister Six group, as Otto Octavius made promises to them in exchange for their help, while Martin Li already shared Otto's distate of Osborn. He has also been searching for weakness to the armor worn by Sable International and has left messages for his "crew". One of them is for Scorpion about a "reservoir job".
Spider-Man sees a map of where each major villain has been assigned to strike at Oscorp. Mister Negative will go after the antiserum for Devil's Breath using "Icarus". Searching the lair further reveals that Icarus itself is just a ruse, as Otto has left behind a case full of explosive that Spider-Man trips upon opening.
Spider-Man escapes via a vent, only to be captured by Vulture and hauled across the city to a waiting Electro. Spider-Man defeats them both. Doctor Octopus over the phone tells Spider-Man that if he truly wanted to help the city, he would expose Osborn's crimes and promised he would have restored New York's power once he was done with Osborn. Spider-Man tells Otto he is sick and needs help, then leaves to take a quick nap to recover.
Walkthrough:
Upon arriving at Times Square, players must complete a spectrograph puzzle in order to conduct their forensics investigation and uncover a dispersal pattern. Following the dispersal trail to the left leads up one of the buildings and into an access hatch. This hatch leads directly into Doctor Octopus's lair, and players then need to use their Electric Web to turn the lights on.
Searching the first few items reveals more about the Sinister Six history. A map rests on a table that appears blank. Nearby sits a UV lamp, however, and players must find the circuit breaker in order to turn it on (Electric Web again). Following further clues to "Icarus" leads to a cutscene, following a boss battle.
Boss battle[]
Players then fight Electro, having to dodge his electrical blasts. Web Shooters stun him enough to get off a few hits, then players need to dodge again. Destroying the transformer brings Vulture into the fight.
Vulture is fought by dodging his charge and blasts and then attacking him with Web Shooters and aerial melee attacks. Fighting solo against him is brief, as Electro then joins back in.
It is especially important to pay attention to Spider-Sense during this phase, as both villains have ranged attacks. Electro will remain hovering in place to send out electrical blasts, while Vulture will charge in or use his own blasts. Another transformer destruction brings the next phase, where players need to follow the on-screen prompts in order to fight Electro, and then the final phase begins.
Electro this time around is taken out quickly when players destroy the final transformer beneath him, and then the fight is just Spider-Man versus Vulture.
When both are defeated, "Streets of Poison" is available.

Story:
After his fight with Electro and Vulture, Spider-Man falls asleep from exhaustion on a rooftop, awakening the next morning. He calls Yuriko Watanabe to let her know he is going after Scorpion at the city's reservoir, believing that New York City would never recover if they lost clean water.
Upon arrival, Scorpion gets the drop on Spider-Man. Scorpion reveals he would prefer to kill Spider-Man, but that Doctor Octopus wants to torture him first. Scorpion then uses his stinger tail to inject Spider-Man with poison. This gives Spider-Man hallucinations of Scorpion and of Otto Octavius telling Peter that he is a failure, while Peter moves around the city to put together an antidote.
Once successful, Spider-Man finds himself back in the lab, having taken the antidote, and in his undies.
Walkthrough:
After the cutscene begins the mission, the environment then changes as Spider-Man hallucinates the entire area is a sea of poison. When players get to higher ground, they can then perform a spectrograph puzzle to determine what toxin was used.
A quick trip to the ESU greenhouse would help in developing an antitoxin, but when players arrive, they are forced into another hallucination environment, this one full of fragmented streets and an Otto Octavius that keeps vanishing as players get close. The end of the sequence results in Spider-Man back in the real world, albeit still hallucinating the sea of poison. With one ingredient in hand, players need to get to one of Harry Osborn's research stations.
For this part, players need to traverse the city while dodging giant scorpion tails that rise up from the poison. Once in the station, another hallucination takes over. Similar to the first, players need to pursue Otto through this sequence, using more advanced webbing techniques. The scene is similar to before, but this time there is more destruction and debris.
More destruction and many more scorpion tails greet players as they return to the real world. With the last of the ingredients he needs, players need to traverse the city and get to Otto's lab to synthesize the antidote. Once there, the final hallucination sequence begins with Doctor Octopus ripping apart the building.
Players fight Scorpion in this round. He can fire poison blasts and leap. Defeating the first is easy, but progressing further involve a fight with multiple Scorpions. They tend to leap around the area for the most part, but players can find themselves fighting more than one at once. Webbing him up is a good strategy, as only a few hits will destroy one of them. Players should be mindful of their tail swipes.
Once successful, Spider-Man is back in Otto's lab. Players can participate in citywide activities and side missions before the next mission, "Supply Run", is available.

Story:
With Scorpion's poison wearing off, Peter Parker decides it is a good time to visit Aunt May. Once there, she appears to be sick. Peter attempts to contact Miles Morales, who has been sent to retrieve more medical supplies from the relief center.
Miles, at the waterfront, steals antibiotics from convicts. After successfully finding the amoxicillin he was looking for, Rhino bursts on the scene, knocking out the Sable International soldiers and interrogating them about their supply routes. Scorpion arrives to assist with the questioning; when he stabs one of the men with his tail, Miles runs, knocking over a toolbox in his haste. Rhino and Scorpion heard the noise, with the former checking the source. There, Miles is forced to try to hide and find a way to escape from Rhino.
Once Miles escapes, he runs into two escaped convicts who are trying to mug a man. He intervenes, fighting one of them, and knocking him out, much to the other's surprise. Miles fearfully asks if he "wanted a taste," and the convict says that he's good, and walks away. As they're dealt with, Pete calls in to Miles, asking him if he's OK, and Miles responded by telling him about what happened.
Walkthrough:
After taking the antidote to counteract Scorpion's poison, players are free to explore the city for a short amount of time before the mission is available. Players can use the map to fast travel to the shelter and begin. After visiting Aunt May, players take control of Miles, who is down near the waterfront.
As Miles, convicts are in the area, and players must sneak around them, making use of the hacking app to distract them. As players successfully locate the antibiotics, a cutscene commences, following which players must evade Rhino.
As with other stealth segments, the path to evade Rhino is mostly linear. Most paths require players to sneak very close to Rhino, so patience is key. The hacking app is also useful on a very occasions in distracting him.
The mission ends with a cutscene, following which "Heavy Hitter" is available.

Story:
After hearing from Miles Morales following his own encounter with Rhino at the relief center, Spider-Man contacts Yuriko Watanabe and lets her know that Rhino is targeting relief centers throughout the city. She directs him to where Rhino likely is: Harlem. While traveling there, Mary Jane Watson calls Spider-Man to reminisce about the time when the two and Harry Osborn had simpler lives, Spider-Man reassuring her that their work is important so the next generation can enjoy the simpler lives they had.
Spider-Man battles the two there. After the battle, Scorpion taunts Rhino a little too much, and Rhino charges him. Spider-Man takes advantage of the situation and seals them both inside a storage container with his webbing. Spider-Man calls Yuri to inform her.
Walkthrough:
The fight with Rhino involves a lot of dodging his charge ability, luring him under the hanging storage containers and other heavy objects to web pull them and smash them on top of him. This presents an opportunity to strike. Each object requires multiple pulls, and they reset to their original height if they do not result in smashing atop Rhino. When Rhino is dealt with, Scorpion then joins in the battle.
Players will now have two enemies to contend with. While dodging Rhino's charge, they will also have to be mindful of Scorpion's ranged poison attack. Dealing with Rhino is the same as before, but with the added trouble of Scorpion leaping in and out of the battle and using his tail strike. Players should focus on taking down Rhino first and simply avoid Scorpion. The overhead objects can still be used, and crates can be pulled down from the side against Rhino, as the fight progresses.
Once Rhino is down, players can then take on Scorpion. He tends to jump around a bit, so backtracking his poison blast is a good way to find him. This part of the fight tends to go quickly, as webbing him up and hitting him does the trick. A cutscene then ends the mission, and the next, "Step Into My Parlor...", is available.
Alternately, the player does not have to defeat Scorpion or Rhino by themselves. Instesd, they can trick the two enemies to hit each other with their attacks. If they fight Scorpion first, and stand next to him, Rhino will charge at the player and also at Scorpion, attacking him in the process; the pair yell and argue at each other. Repeating this action will lead to Rhino eventually knocking Scorpion out. This tactic also works if trying to get Scorpion to accidentally kit Rhino.

Story:
Mary Jane Watson calls Peter Parker to let him know she has not found the location of the Devil's Breath lab. As it was not in the city, state, or federal databases, she suspects the lab is off the books and that its location may be in Norman Osborn's penthouse. With it full of Sable International soldiers, she thinks she has a better chance of sneaking in and avoiding a firefight than Spider-Man. He agrees to wait outside in case she needs backup.
Mary Jane sneaks in through the elevator just as Silver Sable and Normal Osborn exit.
In the penthouse, Mary Jane accesses a secret lab, then witnesses some records and discovers the truth of Mister Negative's origin: that Norman and Otto were working on GR-27 (Devil's Breath) some time ago, and Norman rushed ahead with human trials by giving a young Martin Li the serum when his parents came in for a consultation. Li exhibits his trademark "negative" abilities, appearing to kill both his parents. Mary Jane begins downloading the information, but is startled by a container that holds a jumping bio-engineered spider, causing one of the nearby glass containers to shatter, releasing the spider but also alerting Silver Sable.
As Sable leaves, Mary Jane sneaks out to the balcony. As she takes out the last guard there, he fires a round, alerting the other soldiers. With no other recourse and with Silver Sable and her men approaching, she leaps off the edge, to be caught by Spider-Man below. Spider-Man drops her at the F.E.A.S.T. shelter as she fills him in on Harry's sickness and the origin of Mister Negative, also giving him the location of the Devil's Breath lab.
Walkthrough:
Lobby[]
Players take the role of Mary Jane as she enters the ground floor. With the elevators on lockdown, she needs to access the security room first. To do so, players need to talk with several of the tenants in order for them to get riled up, causing a diversion.
Once in the hall, players find a stun gun, and this becomes the first mission Mary Jane can be used in combat by sneaking up behind guards and stunning them. After stunning the second guard, the security room is to the left. Once the elevator is unlocked, players proceed back to the main foyer.
Penthouse[]
In the penthouse, players pick up a mask on the table near blueprints and, with Mary Jane wearing it, can detect a hidden door in the wall. The clue to the code for the revealed keypad can be found on the dining room table, which then requires players finding the key to Harry Osborn's room. This can be found in the picture frame that shows only his mother, in the same room players can find the picture of Norman and Otto Octavius.
Accessing Harry's room, players find his journal, which supplies his departure date for "Europe" (in reality, entering treatment). This date is also the code for the keypad. Before she can access the hidden room, Silver Sable and Norman return.
After an argument, players need to sneak past the guards to use the access code. The stun gun is still very effective against them, but it is not required to take out all guards. The stun gun can also be used in combination with the lures to separate guards and take them down.
Secret lab[]
In the secret lab, players need to deduce the location of the Devil's Breath lab using the large computerized map in the center of the room. It will end up being the building the furthest to the right, after selecting Dr. Michaels for VIPS, Defense for Oscorp buildings, and Alpha Patrol for Sable patrols. Finding the building leads to a cutscene.
Once the cutscene ends, players need to sneak out of the lab and to the balcony. As before, the stun gun can be effective against guards. Reaching the balcony leads to a cutscene and completes the mission. The penultimate mission, "The Heart of the Matter", is then available.

Story:
Spider-Man heads off to retrieve the antiserum. Along the way, Spider-Man calls Yuriko Watanabe to tell her he is finding the cure. Yuri then informs him that a helicopter just went down at the address of the secret lab.
Mister Negative has captured Norman, and his Inner Demons patrol the ground and rooftops outside. Spider-Man defeats them. Sable International troops arrive and attack Spider-Man. At the culmination of the fight, Silver Sable appears. Sable threatens to kill Spider-Man for his damage to her men and her client, but listening to his logic, she finally decides that they are better off working together rather than against each other and agrees to a temporary truce until Norman is secure. She allows him into the building, but when Inner Demons show up outside, she stays behind to fend them off, leaving him to follow Li's trail through the building.
After reaching Li, Li gets the jump on Spider-Man as he enters the lower level, and Li sends Spider-Man to a "negative zone" to try and convince him again. When Spider-Man exits, Norman is screaming in the other room. Dr. Morgan Michaels then gives Li the only sample of an antiserum developed against Devil's Breath, and Li tortures Osborn before Spider-Man interrupts and battles him. Spider-Man tries to  urge Li that Osborn deserves true justice, which will not happen if Li continues to be violent, though Li is undeterred.
Upon Li's defeat, Doctor Octopus enters the room. Via cutscene, he fights Spider-Man and knocks him out, taking the antiserum for himself. He then takes Norman and heads out of the building. Silver Sable rushes in moments later to find Spider-Man on the floor, mortally wounded. Sable and Dr. Michaels take him to F.E.A.S.T., where Dr. Michaels works to save his life.
Though he is saved, Spider-Man insists on finding the antiserum before resting, especially when he learns Aunt May is sick and in bed from the Devil's Breath. Mary Jane insists he use his brains to defeat Otto rather than relying solely on his spider-powers. At the scene's end, a spider from Osborn's lab that hitched a ride on Mary Jane's coat bites Miles Morales.
Walkthrough:
At the lab, Inner Demons patrol the ground and rooftops. Players need to take them out, and can either use stealth or combat to do so, depending on player preference. Stealth may be easier to preserve health early on, though a battle will occur regardless eventually.
After the battle against Demons, Sable troops arrive, some with rocket launchers and some with jetpacks. Taking out the rocket launcher enemies first is ideal, making it easier to take the jetpack troopers out with aerial attacks thereafter.
Entering the building leads to a brief cutscene after which players must follow Li's trail. Players should be careful when contacting the areas of negative energy, as they can cause significant damage. Following it eventually leads to a brief cutscene and then a short segment in the negative zone. Here, players must chase Li throughout it before a brief cutscene as he exits.
Mister Negative boss battle[]
After attempting to intervene, players then face off against Mister Negative. His skill set has increased since the previous battle, as he now wields an electrical blade and is swift moving. Hurtling debris at him helps, but webbing does not. Players need to keep mobile to avoid the attacks, getting hits in when they can.
After Li takes enough damage, a brief cutscene begins following which Li summons a large demon in the negative zone, along with several smaller demons then appear. Once the initial enemies are dealt with, the demon will return with a sweep attack that must be dodged. It will make more appearances as the fight continues, summoning more enemies.
Staying airborne and using debris to smash into Mister Negative works well as it means most of the attacks can be avoided. Throwing objects at Li and using melee attacks against him will eventually defeat him, and a cutscene ends the mission. The final mission, "Pax in Bello", can then be begun.

Story:
On the way to the lab at Octavius Industries, Silver Sable calls to let Spider-Man know she is leaving the city, having doubts as to her chosen life, but that her soldiers will remain behind. With no time left, Mary Jane informs via phone call that May Parker’s condition is worsening because of being infected by Devil's Breath. Even worse, Yuriko Watanabe and most of the police officers are infected by Devil's Breath, Yuri staying with her mother, who is also infected.
Once in the lab, Peter creates a suit designed specifically to defeat Doctor Octopus: the Anti-Ock Suit. After suiting up, an incoming news alert lets him know where Octopus has kidnapped Norman and climbed into the tower. There, Doctor Octopus climbs up the Oscorp's tower, attempting to force the Mayor into admitting his failings. When Norman refuses, Octopus drops him. Spider-Man manages to catch Norman in time, allowing him to flee before approaching Octopus on the roof. He makes one last-ditch effort to dissuade Otto but he fails, leading them to fight.
After Peter rips out Otto's neural interface, Otto reveals that he knew Spider-Man was Peter all along. The two fight, and the tower is ripped free from the roof to send them both tumbling over at the edge. The two fight on the side of the tower. When Octopus stabs him with an arm, Spider-Man pulls the arm in closer, taking advantage of the moment to rip the interface free again.
Otto falls, and Spider-Man follows to retrieve the antiserum. They crash into the side of the tower and into a room, where Otto is unable to move. Otto first accuses Peter of betrayal, but Peter responds that Otto's willpower and conscience made him the hero that he wanted to be. Though Otto then attempts to convince Spider-Man that his actions were all the result of the interface, Spider-Man takes the antiserum and turns away, letting the authorities take him in.
Walkthrough:
Entering the lab is the last chance to upgrade gear and abilities before the final boss battle (although they can still be upgraded and side missions can still be completed after the fact). Once this is done, a cutscene leads into the final battle.
Doctor Octopus has a ranged attack he can perform with his arms; players are clued-in on when this will happen when he begins to pull one of them back. The arms can be used in tandem to slam the ground. He also performs a leap attack and can grab Spider-Man. Players will need to be mindful about the on-screen prompt to free themselves. Webbing works against his arms, and the suit allows for refills of gadgets. There are some objects that can be thrown, but those run out quickly. As the fight progresses, Octopus will start throwing chunks of the building. These can be caught and thrown back, but players have to react quickly in order to do so.
The next phase begins when Octopus climbs the tower and causes it to explode. The entire roof on the tower then becomes dangerous for players, who must keep moving and remain airborne. The tower chunks fall, and players need to catch at least one to throw it back to stun Octopus. They then must charge in and knock him from the tower so the roof will be safe again. Once more up the tower he will go, and when players stun him this time, Spider-Man is able to rip out the neural interface.
The next section is a battle on the side of the building. In this, only dodges and punches are available, and dodges are crucial as Spider-Man's health is not visible. Dealing enough damage to Octopus will complete the boss battle, leading to a cutscene and the end of the main story.

After arriving at the place of the police call, press  to the Spider-Drone him. You will have 2 minutes to find four bombs by using vibrations and beeps. When you find bombs,  to short-circuit them.
After this, new Maggia crimes are available around New York City. These crimes can include car bomb crimes in which the Spider-Drone disables bombs, but also includes other types of crimes seen in the main game. Shortly after this, the next mission, "Long Lost Loot", is available after Spider-Man hears a phonecall.

Story:
NYPD's Detective Mackey contacts Spider-Man to come in Greenwich's PD. There he tells him that 20 years before Felicia Hardy there was "another black cat" who recently died in prison. Some of the items he stole were never found, and though there is a new lead that may help find them, the department do not want to deal with an old case. Spider-Man agrees to help and goes to Midtown.
While Peter swings to the place, Mackey tells him that Black Cat can be using special isotope americium-241 to locate his hideouts after prison and that this case is very important to him since he is going to retire soon and want to solve him as soon as possible. With that information Peter configures he's detector to search for traces of isotope and finds false power supply on the roof of Chrysler Building.
In the false power supply, Spider-Man finds a stolen painting, "Freedom". Mackey thanks Spider-Man and tells that he will send somebody to collect them and that the first Black Cat's name was Walter Hardy and gives him locations of other stolen paintings. Peter highlights that this seems to be a Hardy family trait.
Walkthrough:
"Freedom"
Reach the location on the waypoint to reach the building, then follow the compass to find the stolen painting. It is located in a fake power box on a balcony near the top of the building. Use  +  to open it and retrieve the painting "Freedom".
From this point, the Hardy's Stolen Art series of side missions is available, involving finding similar stolen art pieces around New York City and culminates in a final side mission. Shortly after the mission ends, a call from Mary Jane Watson opens up the next story mission, "Like Old Times". The Hardy's Stolen Art series can be completed any time, including right now to finish its side mission, if desired before moving onto the next story mission.

Story:
Peter arrives at the location and stops the gang war. Interrogating one of the thugs, Spider-Man discovers that that was a distraction for the police from one of the Cicero family's stores. At the store he finds claw marks and observation post and sees Black Cat sneaking into Cicero's hideout. He tries to stop her, but she leaves with a data drive and leaves him to the thugs of Cicero family.
After short battle, Spider-Man meets Black Cat at the roof nearby and asks why she's helping Hammerhead. She says that Hammerhead kidnapped her son and leaves Spider-Man in shock and with thoughts about his possible connection with the boy. Spider-Man chooses not to disclose this to Mary Jane Watson after calling her.
Walkthrough:
After reaching the location of the mission, a battle against the Maggia begins. Though the first group of enemies are standard enemies fought before where the usual tactics apply, eventually, a brute carrying a Gatling gun arrives.
Gatling gun brutes are much harder than typical brutes, as they cannot be webbed up as easily, and their gunfire can deal significant damage. Instead, there are two options: either using two Focus bars for a Takedown (the simplest path), or avoiding their attacks and throwing melee attacks until they fall. It may be easiest to fight other enemies to build Focus for a Takedown (or simply use Battle Focus), but this option is not always available, at which point melee attacks are the only way to go against these brutes since webs are largely ineffective.
Following the battle, a cutscene leads to the next portion of the mission. Follow the waypoint to reach Black Cat's stakeout gear. This is similar to the Black Cat Stakeouts from the main game; aiming the camera at the rooftop directly in front of where it is facing will find the mascot and lead to Black Cat. After following her there, a cutscene commences, and a battle against Maggia, including a Gatling gun brute, is fought.
When the battle is complete, a cutscene commences and ends the mission and opens the next, "Something is Screwy".

Story: After Spider-Man calls Mary Jane Watson about Black Cat stealing a data drive, Screwball calls him to tell him she is out of jail and is putting on a show in Midtown with the help of her fans (former convicts). Once Spider-Man defeats them, she infomrs him he will be the main star of her reality show. He declines, but she responds that her fans will hurt people around the city if he does, giving him no choice.
Walkthrough:
After heading to the location on the waypoint marker, a number of inmates are present. These are mostly standard enemies and there is the option to either use stealth or combat. In combat, Web Bombs and the Suspension Matrix are effective as is using the Concussive Blast to simply push them off buildings, and for stealth, using the yankable objects is helpful.
Once all are taken out, investigate the projector to lead to a short cutscene. The Screwball Challenges are then available all around the city for tokens. These are very similar to Taskmaster Challenges with new additions. The challenge here is the first of these new types: the EMP Challenge, which requires Spider-Man to follow a specific trail and use Web Shooters to disable them before moving to the next one on the trail, and do so quickly. In these challenges, photobombs are present on the way: you must navigate through (or in some challenges, defeat enemies in) these photobombs and then press  when the gauge is full for added points, necessary for the top scores.
After the mission ends, and after completing one citywide task (possibly the challenge here at the end of this mission), you can continue the main story when Mary Jane Watson calls leading to the next, "Trail of the Cat".

Story:
Spider-Man investigates the location in Greenwich that Mary Jane mentioned. There, he sees a police blockade and an injured security guard. At the crime scene, he finds volume two of a book, which he deduces does not contain a Maggia flash drive, and near a Macchio crime family pawnshop, puts together a trail that leads him to "Vito", a man from the Macchio family who appears to have been taken out by Black Cat.
The trail continues to an area overlooking Hammerhead thugs, as Spider-Man sees that the book Black Cat gave them did not contain the flash drive. Black Cat told the thug she gave it to that she wanted to deliver the drive to Hammerhead herself, leading the other thugs to beat execute him for believing her and not following orders, at which point Spider-Man interrupts them. He then gives the book to the police, having not retrieved the drive.
With this, only one drive with data on the Maggia families remains before Black Cat has the drives on all the Maggia families. Spider-Man calls Mary Jane and informs her of this, and the fact that Black Cat is working for Hammerhead as he has her son. The conversation ends awkwardly when Spider-Man admits to her that if Black Cat does have a son, he could be the father.
Walkthrough:
Around the crime scene, investigate the book and the spilled liquid near the pawnshop. After completing the puzzle here, follow the trail leads to a member of the Macchio crime family, and a battle begins against Maggia thugs. The battle is fairly straightforward, and once beat, continue the trail. This leads to another battle against Maggia, with brutes participating also. The Impact Web here is effective at webbing enemies to walls.
Once complete, after a call with Mary Jane ends the mission, you are free to patrol New York City and complete tasks (such as crimes, Screwball Challenges, or Hardy's Stolen Art), before she calls Spider-Man again for the next mission, "Pursuing the Truth".

Story:
Mary Jane gives Spider-Man the address of the Costa family safe and likely location of the final drive. She tells Spider-Man she forgives him in case he did have a son with Black Cat, and quickly changes the subject to the Maggia drives. She tells him that years ago, the families agreed to a joint accounting databse to keep the peace but require all five data drives to access it, and that Hammerhead wants to steal these assets from other families and bankrupt them.
At the address, Spider-Man finds Black Cat having already taken the drive. Black Cat throws an EMP grenade disabling Spider-Man's webs and runs throughout the city. Spider-Man chases her, trying to convince her to trust him, but she continues to flee through the subway and then through the city.
Spider-Man reaches her and urges her not to give Hammerhead the drives as it would make Hammerhead too dangerous. The two agree to work together, stalling Hammerhead while they look for Black Cat's son separately. She refuses to answer when he asks if her son is his. Spider-Man then calls Mary Jane to give her the update, and Mary Jane warns against trusting her but agrees to help find Hammerhead. Exhausted, Spider-Man calls Eddie's Pizza for a pizza. On the way, Miles Morales calls Spider-Man to ask about possibly training him.
Walkthrough:
The mission is a chase against Black Cat, with no webs initially. Instead, simply run forward holding  to chase her and run over the objects on the way. The chase is scripted until an  prompt leads to the a brief cutscene and the next part of the chase.
When the chase continues, Spider-Man's webs return as he chases her through the subway. Using Point Launches will help reach the train, though it is important to avoid the electricity on the way. After getting through, the next section requires swinging around the city. Upon closing in on her, use  to web and slow her down. When Spider-Man mentions he can get close, reach her and use the  prompt to end the mission.
Thereafter, citywide activities, crimes, Screwball Challenges, or Hardy's Stolen Art can be complete before the next mission, "Newsflash", is available.

Story: Spider-Man stops by Eddie's Pizza for dinner. Mary Jane calls him when she is at the compound, and Spider-Man promises to be there shortly when he is finished eating. When she infiltrates, she finds no sign of a child, but does find counterfeit money and an unguarded laptop with a shipping manifest. She hears them talk about the Costa family and that the Maggia are trying to diffuse the situation, but leaves.
Walkthrough:
This is a typical Mary Jane stealth mission from the main story, though lures and stun gun are available to take out guards. On the way, Mary Jane must take photos of evidence. The first are of a pile of counterfeit bills, then a pile of bags of counterfeit money, and finally two men near a laptop. After this, a brief cutscene commences.
The rest of the mission simply requires escaping. Not all the guards need to be defeated, but the stun gun makes it relatively easy to do so. Avoid the boxes and flee on the left side of the track at the exit to complete the mission. After this, Black Cat calls Spider-Man, leading to "Cover for the Cat".

Story:
Black Cat calls Spider-Man giving him a location, then hangs up before he can inquire more. Once there, she asks him to create a distraction, saying that a tip from an old friend told her that Hammerhead was keeping something valuable in the office above the bar, and that her son would be killed if she was seen there. Spider-Man draws the thugs out so she can sneak in.
After the two join forces, Black Cat reveals she has narrowed down the location of the vault where he son is being kept. When Spider-Man asks her if he is the father, she flirts with him instead and laments she was unable to give up thieving, before leaving and promising to call him if she needs help accessing the vault. Mary Jane Watson calls Spider-Man to tell him she is still decrypting the files on the laptop, and Spider-Man updates her. Meanwhile, Miles Morales updates Spider-Man, telling him he is playing basketball, and Spider-Man encourages him to keep his play believable, and promises to think about training Miles.
Walkthrough:
This is primarily a combat mission, though after reaching the entrance Black Cat points to, stealth can be used to thin out the number of guards. The battle is relatively lengthy, and later into the mission, brutes, and Gatling gun brutes appear. When the Gatling gun brutes appear, Black Cat will also join the battle, helping fight the smaller thugs.
Web Bombs and Impact Webs are useful against the other brutes when used in enclosed spaces. The Suspension Matrix can be used both for the Web Bomb combo and for putting a few thugs out of commission while focusing down the larger brutes.
After this, citywide activities must be done before the next and final mission, "Follow the Money", is complete, at which point Mary Jane calls Spider-Man when she has decryped the laptop.

Story:
Mary Jane Watson calls Spider-Man and lets him know she has finished decrypting the laptop, and located a record of Hammerhead's vault near Hell's Kitchen. Spider-Man calls Black Cat to give her the address of the vault, and the two meet up there and take out the Hammerhead guards. Once cleared out, Spider-Man opens the shipping containers and finds that Hammerhead has Sable International weapons.
After battling them, Spider-Man enters the vault only to be trapped in there by Black Cat, as she reveals she never had a son but rather just wanted to take Hammerhead's USB drive. Because she gave Hammerhead fake drives, she now has the wealth of all Maggia families.
As Black Cat as she leaves Spider-Man trapped there, he learns that Hammerhead has a tracker on the drive and has Black Cat's penthouse rigged to blow, no longer caring about the drives and focusing on killing her. Spider-Man tries to save her, though she blows him off when he calls her. Seeing her penthouse explode with her seemingly there, Black Cat is presumed dead. Later, Peter Parker gives Mary Jane Watson an update, suspecting Black Cat may have survived, and Mary Jane tells him he will be a great dad one day.
Walkthrough:
The mission begins with a required stealth segment. In addition to the usual Perch Takedown and Web Strike Takedown movements, Spider-Man can also use  to call for a Black Cat Takedown to have Black Cat take out a guard she is targeting when she is close enough.
Black Cat Takedown comes in handy in a few situations when taking out two guards at once; if one guard is watching another one, taking out one while calling Black Cat to take out the other is an effective strategy. Otherwise, strategies are similar to usual stealth segments; distract guards to separate them, and then take them down.
Once the guards are taken out, after a cutscene, open several containers continue the mission. Hammerhead guards then arrive for a combat segment, using stronger weapons. Web Bomb, Suspension Matrix, and Spider-Drones can be used, and it is important to disarm the Hammerhead thugs of their more powerful weapons, especially when rocket launcher guards arrive. Finishers should be saved up for when battling the Gatling gun brutes.
After the combat segment, head into the vault for a brief cutscene. This follows a segment in which Spider-Man must swing to her penthouse. Reaching it leads to a cutscene and closes out the mission.
With the mission complete, it is now possible to complete all side missions from "The Heist". The story is continued in "Turf Wars", with its first mission being "Blindsided".

Story: At the Bar with No Name, Spider-Man agrees not to battle due to how difficult his last battle there was, choosing instead to send in his Spider-Bot. Inside, by overhearing conversations, Spider-Man learns that Hammerhead is augmenting himself, attempting to take out the Maggia dons ton control the Maggia. After reaching Vinny and Gino inside, Spider-Bot learns they are at the Aurebach Theater and calls Mary Jane Watson to give her information on Maggia fronts.
Walkthrough:
As Spider-Bot, avoid any of the guards at all costs. After descending the initial staircase, use a ramp on the left to head to the railing above the main room, and the EMP with  will stop the fans and allow entrance.
Inside the bar, reach certain tables and match their wavelength to hear their conversation and move on. Past the first table, head to the kitchen behind the bar, and follow it to the bar counter below to reach the main floor of the bar. Next, move to the tables next to two groups of highlighted guards and listen in while beneath the tables. Another group can be listened to when beneath the pool table.
Following this conversation, use EMP next to an outlet near the pinball machines to shut the lights down. When Dino opens the door to the back, head to the back room and use the ramps to get up to the map and take a picture. Heading through the bathroom and through a vent leads to Vinny and Gino.
In Vinny and Gino's room, the Spider-Bot must distract them to pull them away from the table with the maps. To do this, the first can be distracted by disabling an outlet on the floor, while the second can be distracted by disabling an outlet found by climbing the ramp near the table to get up. Once up here, the Spider-Bot can take a picture of the map on the table.
With the mission complete, Maggia Fronts are available to complete at any time, though the mission "Jury Rigging" is also available to start immediately.

Story: When Spider-Man arrives at the dispatch, he finds the police debating if they should call for backup due to how short the drive is, but chooses to follow along closely. The police remain doubtful that anything will happen, until they are attacked along the way. Spider-Man saves the witness and defeats the thugs.
Walkthrough:
Following the vehicle for a little, several Hammerhead thugs block the road, including a few with guns, brutes, and some with shields. Saving Focus against the jetpack thugs is best as they are most difficult to defeat, while the normal thugs and brutes are defeated easily with gadgets.
When the mission is complete, Yuriko Watanabe calls Spider-Man and the next mission, "Last Stand", is available. Additionally, new crimes are available around the city including crimes similar to this where Spider-Man must follow a witness' car before battling thugs near the end.

Story:
Yuriko Watanabe calls Spider-Man for an update, after she has finished calling her men's families. Spider-Man informs her of the lead and heads to the theater where the dons are safe. When there, he finds that Hammerhead is using new Sable International tech that is capable of burrowing underground and sees that the theater is under attack.
After defeating them and diffusing bombs nearby, he finds that the dons have already been kidnapped by the burrowing devices, and calls Yuri. Yuri sounds distressed and disappointed, and promises to end her break to find Hammerhead.
Walkthrough:
The mission opens with a battle outside the theater. As groups of guards are defeated, new ones appear from the ground arriving through the burrowing devices, and later thugs are found on the rooftops. Take out the rocket launcher thugs before diffusing the bombs, which can be done simply by web throwing, as there is plenty of time for this.
Once all are defused, zip through the vent to head inside, for a brief cutscene that ends the mission. A call from Screwball opens the next mission, "Season Two".

Story: After taking Screwball's call, Spider-Man initially blows her off but entertains her eventually. When he arrives for the challenge, he jokes that he is in talks with a competing subscription service, but she responds that her fans will leave behind angry flash mobs.
Walkthrough:
Reaching the stream relay will unlock the challenges. Any challenge can be complete to finish the mission, but the challenge that the mission waypoint leads to is a stealth challenge where the objective is to defeat all enemies as quickly as possible without alerting the enemies. Use of gadgets, Web Strike Takedowns, and Perch Takedowns is required, but in Screwball's stealth challenges, it is important to defeat enemies in the Photobomb areas for additional points.
Once a challenge is complete to finish the mission, Yuriko Watanabe calls Spider-Man for the next mission, "Lockup". Screwball Challenges can also be completed any time for tokens.

Story:
Yuri calls Spider-Man to ask for help with her plan: split the Sable technology around New York City, giving Hammerhead multiple targets to force him to thin his men out. She asks Spider-Man to protect the gear transports, which he agrees, sensing the fear and urgency in Yuri's voice.
Spider-Man protects a convoy from rooftop snipers, and then from burrowing tanks. After protecting the first convoy, a second is then under attack. Spider-Man stops them, but Yuri tells Spider-Man that Hammerhead was luring Spider-Man away, and beckons him back to the precinct. Once there, Spider-Man finds the place suffering heavy damage from an attack. Yuri now seems uninterested in Spider-Man's help, threatening to arrest him if he does not stay out of her way.
Walkthrough:
The mission begins similarly to escort crimes: follow the truck transport (you can simply stand on top of it) until Hammerhead snipers are spotted atop buildings. Take out the first group, and as the convoy proceeds, a larger, second group of snipers is then found.
When the truck arrives in Central Park, a larger group of Hammerhead thugs is fought from burrowers. In the small enclosed space of Central Park's tunnel, web gadgets can be very effective, though when some appear above the tunnel, melee combat may be the better choice.
After this is cleared, a convoy across the city is also attacked. Upon reaching it, attempt to use a stealth takedown on one of the Gatling gun brutes as these are the most challenging to take out, then proceed with the fight as normal. After they are defeated, groups take some of the trucks, which can be chased down and stopped in a manner similar to car crimes.
Once they are stopped, Spider-Man must return to the precinct. After reaching it, a cutscene ends the mission. Citywide activities should be complete before the next mission, "Yuri's Revenge", is available.

Story:
Spider-Man arrives at the Bar with No Name before the police does. As he enters the building, he finds it to be a wreck and sees that the thugs were killed, suspecting they died at the hands of Yuriko Watanabe. The Spider-Bot, whom he sent into the bar to eavesdrop earlier, is still intact. He sees a cell phone vibrating, Gino's phone, and picks up a call from Vinny, who reveals "the Big Show" in which Hammerhead plans to kill the Maggia dons.
Spider-Man visits Mercy General hospital, as Vinny is dropping his injured men there. He then tracks Vinny and follows his car to the docks. After listening into the Hammerhead thugs, he learns that Hammerhead is planning something for the Maggia dons at Hudson Yards, and then takes them out. On the way there, Miles Morales calls to say he is at hospital after breaking a toe after jumping off a bridge in Queens to test his powers, and Peter Parker wishes him luck then promises him another lesson that weekend.
Walkthrough:
Heading to the Bar with No Name, simply following waypoints to investigate clears the first portion of the mission, before it then proceeds to the Mercy General hospital. There, after using  to scan, simply wall crawl around the hospital and reach the signals. Wall crawl to the center of them and hold  until the correct signal is hit.
After finding Vinny, follow his car by swinging (though Spider-Man mentions he should not stay too close, this will not affect the mission too much). It will lead to the docks. Here, the objective is to listen into groups of thugs. It is easiest to take down the snipers first before listening to them, and then listen to each group. After listening to a conversation, the thugs can be taken down quietly.
Once all conversations are listened to, the thugs can be fought. Once all are defeated, the final mission, "Bring the Hammer Down", commences.

Story:
When Spider-Man arrives on scene, Hammerhead welcomes him to the live broadcast in which the Maggia dons are to be killed live in a pit slowly filling with cement. He wishes to return to the days in which the Maggia were feared and respected. Spider-Man stops the thugs from pouring in more cement, before heading to the building to battle Hammerhead.
Hammerhead reveals, with Project Olympus, he has become more immortal, and a stronger leader for the Maggia to take seriously. Spider-Man defeats him, and the police arrive to Hammerhead under arrest. Hammerhead is undeterred, until Yuri arrives, trapping Spider-Man with one of Sable's cable traps, before shooting Hammerhead with a Sable gun. She then reminds him of his earlier words to her about fear, as Hammerhead shows visible fear of her himself.
Spider-Man tries to stop Yuri from shooting and killing Hammerhead, but she is surrounded by the police, and stares them down knowing they have seen what she has done. Hammerhead is taken away and presumed dead, although a Hammerhead thug inside the force is able to revive him due to his Project Olympus augmentations.
Walkthrough:
The first part of the mission is a long combat section in which Spider-Man must battle thugs to prevent them from pouring in more cement. The nearby vehicles make for convenient spots to use Web Bombs and Trip Mines, but otherwise, aerial melee combat is preferred, especially against shielded enemies. Focus should be saved for the Gatling gun brutes.
Later in the battle, the cement mixer shorts out and Spider-Man must web it to keep it shut. After beating the remaining thugs and stopping it, a cutscene leads to the next portion.
Hammerhead boss battle[]
Hammerhead has powerful laser attacks at range that leave behind red electricity. His melee attacks comprise two leaps toward Spider-Man, both of which must be dodged in quick succession. Hammerhead will shrug off Spider-Man's melee attacks in normal circumstances, and his own melee attacks are extremely strong.
The best way to deal damage to Hammerhead is to either dodge his attacks and Web Strike in to attack, to web uo him with Web Shooters or Impact Webs and then attack, or to use Finishers. Because his attacks are extremely strong, it is more important to dodge his attacks than it is to attack him. Hammerhead will summon several other thugs throughout the fight, and these must be defeated first, both to build Focus for Finishers against Hammerhead, and to make it easier to focus on Hammerhead's attacks rather than theirs.
As the fight proceeds, the number of thugs summoned by Hammerhead continues. Despite this, it is still possible to defeat all thugs around him so as to focus on him. The fight has two phases, separated by a cutscene. After the second, he is defeated.
Completing the mission concludes "Turf Wars". At this point, any uncompleted side missions around this DLC can be complete, or the next chapter, "Silver Lining", can be begun with its first mission, "Old Friends".

Story: After battling Silver Sable, Spider-Man phones Mary Jane Watson to discuss Sable's return. However, their call is hijacked by Screwball, who directs Spider-Man to Eighth and Perlman. Upon arrival and approaching the camera, Screwball announces the third season of her show with the promise of a party after hitting fifty million followers. Spider-Man takes the show's opportunity to defeat her for good.
Walkthrough:
As with previous missions, once begun, one challenge needs to be complete, which may or may not be the challenge that the mission's story leads to. The challenge in question is a bomb challenge, similar to previous Taskmaster Challenges with the exception that Photobombs are involved when throwing bombs and that the crates with the bombs need to be broken first. This can be done easiest by flying over the bombs and using a Ground Strike attack. A bomb is also present in a truck, which must be stopped in a manner similar to typical car crimes.
Once a challenge is done, after a call with Mary Jane, Spider-Man must complete more citywide activities (which could be another Screwball Challenge) before the next mission, "Rio Bravo", is available.

Story: Spider-Man is alerted by the police dispatch to a report of a truck driver in distress in the Financial District. As he swings over, he gets a call from Miles Morales, who is confused about getting physics homework for his "spider-assignments", and explains that understanding physics is essential to web-swinging. Upon arrival, Spider-Man finds out that Hammerhead thugs are attacking an Oscorp truck, and decides to help.
Walkthrough:
This mission is essentially players' introduction to Tech Salvage crimes. Throughout this mission, Spider-Man must defend the Oscorp truck from Hammerhead thugs. A circular gauge is visible near the truck's door, and it rises as thugs try to break open the door.
Players can defeat the Hammerhead thugs any way they choose, but must keep track of the gauge lest the Hammerhead thugs raise it to full. Only two thugs are attacking the truck at first, but more thugs come in waves, including brutes and jetpack thugs. Because many are close to the trucks, Web Bombs and other gadgets can take advantage of this.
Completing the mission unlocks crimes around New York City. Future Tech Salvage crimes play out similarly to this mission where Hammerhead thugs attempt to steal from trucks. Additionally, completing the mission unlocks the next mission, "Together But Alone".

Story:
Mary Jane Watson points Spider-Man to the shipping facility, as Hammerhead is stealing weapons bound for Symkaria. Pointing out that, given Hammerhead men have stolen most Sable International weapons, a lot in police lockup, and is now stealing more bound for Symkaria, she questions where he is keeping it, and decides to look for Hammerhead bases. She also talks about the Symkaria civil war against its ruling dictator, and the fact that Silver Sable needs the weapons to fight the war.
As Spider-Man arrives, trucks loading up Project Olympus equipment leaves, and Spider-Man chases them down. Spider-Man tries to stop the truck to stop Sable from shooting and accidentally hurting someone, and stops more Hammerhead cars and stolen tanks on his own. When her jet is attacked by drones, he also latches on and web shoots them down. Sable does not thank him or respond.
Sable then shoots the final truck and holds a Hammerhead thug at gunpoint to make him talk, though he accepts his death as Hammerhead would kill him instead. Spider-Man stops her from killing him and encourages her to work with him, which she begrudingly agrees to while placing a tracker on his suit and leaving.
Walkthrough:
The beginning of the mission leads to a truck chase, which plays out identically to previous truck chases. Spider-Man must stop two trucks, as well as two escorting cars. Stopping the first truck and one car causes Silver Sable to arrive in her jet, and for more Hammerhead cars to arrive.
While Sable's jet is chasing, Spider-Man must initially stop more cars. Rocket fire from stolen Sable tanks will sometimes leave behind blasts in the air that are deadly for Spider-Man, which can normally be avoided with point launches.
After stopping a few more, drones will attack Sable's jets, which Spider-Man must stop with Web Shooters by pressing  in the air. The first few drones are stopped by swinging in as close to the drones as possible, and then shooting. The timing of this can be challenging: shooting too far away from them will cause them to miss, and while Spider-Man is shooting mid-air, he will lose momentum. As such, it is important to get in as close as possible before shooting.
When prompted, latch onto Sable's jets to shoot down the rest of the drones. After latching onto it, this part simply requires shooting as no aiming is needed. From here, Spider-Man will jump off, and simply needs to latch onto the last truck to end the mission. The next, "Humanitarian Aid", is immediately available.

Story: Spider-Man hears about an assault in progress from the police dispatch, and upon reaching it, he sees Hammerhead's crew attacking David Obademi. After protecting him, David thanks him for the help and tells him about his quest to send humanitarian supplies to Symkaria, telling him Hammerhead has stolen most of the supplies after the attack. Spider-Man promises to look out for more if he finds any.
Walkthrough:
The mission is a simple combat mission near the truck, and the usual web gadgets and melee combat can defeat them. Once done, a call from Mary Jane Watson leads to "Trust Issues", the next mission.

Story:
Mary Jane passes on a lead from one of her jailhouse sources that some of Hammerhead's men frequent a certain pizza shop that can help lead Spider-Man to the people he is looking for. Spider-Man then laments that he and Mary Jane do not get time to call about real lives like normal people, and Mary Jane encourages Spider-Man to work better with Silver Sable.
Spider-Man, as Peter Parker, trails Hammerhead men who discuss a man named "Tony" who is tight with the boss, and whose laptop has important info. Spider-Man uses the laptop to then find Tony's location. Once there, Silver Sable comes out of invisibility and demands an address from Tony, to which he responds the Colexco building rooftop is where Hammerhead wants to meet Sable. Spider-Man follows her there, calling her to try and urge her not to walk into a trap, but she is undeterred.
At the top of the building, Sable's jet is held in place. Spider-Man frees her and she urges him to stay and fight there, as Hammerhead will come to them. Hammerhead eventually latches onto Sable's jet and deals heavy damage, Spider-Man unable to fight back against him. Before he can kill them, Black Cat rescues Spider-Man while Sable's jet crashes, Hammerhead taking her to his hideout.
Meanwhile, Black Cat reveals that Spider-Man was tracked by Sable and that she was following the same tracker. She urges Spider-Man not to battle Hammerhead as he is too powerful, but nonetheless gives him Hammerhead's flash drive that should give him a way to beat him, before briefly apologizing to him and cryptically says that Hammerhead's head is "not as strong as you think it is". The drive reveals Hammerhead's Olympus Hideouts, and Spider-Man calls David Obademi to tell him that, knowing the location of the hideouts, he may know the location of the humanitarian aid that was bound for Symkaria.
Walkthrough:
As the mission begins, Spider-Man will change into his normal Peter Parker attire and walk around New York City. The first section is linear as Peter follows two Hammerhead thugs. Peter can follow relatively close by, and stick close to crowds. Holding  allows him to blend in more easily, particularly near crowds.
When Hammerhead's men head to the parking lot, Peter must head to an alleyway opposite to climb up walls to buildings above. After climbing, while still in Peter Parker costume, typical Spider-Man controls apply and can be used to zip to the buildings overlooking the lot. After listening in, a fight sequence begins as Spider-Man.
The fight sequence in the lot is relatively standard as none of the thugs are armed with Sable International weapons. Once they are defeated, Spider-Man must find the laptop from the cars in the lot. The car with the laptop is the third one from the top in the C (middle) rail, and yanking it will reveal the laptop. Zipping up to it leads to a brief cutscene at which point there is a new wapoint to follow.
The waypoint leads to an alley where another battle begins. After it is complete, a brief cutscene commences, following which Spider-Man must follow Sable to the Colexco building.
At the top of the building, a larger battle commences against Hammerhead thugs. First destroy the generators holding Silver Sable's jet in place, at which point a battle against Hammerhead thugs armed with Sable tech begins. Save Focus for the larger brutes and otherwise use a mix of gadgets and combat against the enemies as usual. When all are defeated, a cutscene ends the mission.
With the mission ended, new Olympus Hideouts are available around New York, along with the next mission, "Getting Deep".

Story:
Spider-Man heads to the sewers where the base is located. After heading through the sewers and an abandoned subway platform to reach the base, Spider-Man learns about Project Olympus at one of Hammerhead's base.
In one old recording at the base, Hammerhead demands an Oscorp scientist work for Hammerhead or he will be made a test subject. In another, impressed by how Sable International took over the city so quickly, Hammerhead plans to steal more and wishes to lure Silver Sable there to get all the equipment he needs. In a third, Hammerhead, after nearly dying at Yuriko Watanabe's hands, demands the Oscorp scientist make him less human to make him indestructible.
Spider-Man finds Silver Sable tortured by a Hammerhead thug, who used a drill in her shoulders to torture her. When Spider-Man frees her, Silver Sable thanks him but initially responds that she works alone, but Spider-Man eventually convinces her they should work together by saying he knows a way to beat him. The two both come to the realization that Hammerhead's plate in his head is carbon steel and thus sensitive to heat, and she promises to call him for more.
Walkthrough:
The first segment of the mission is a traversal section as Spider-Man must swing through the sewers to reach the abandoned subway platform. This is a mostly linear area, and Point Launches make it quick.
After reaching the abandoned subway platform, several Hammerhead men patrol the area. These can either be taken out with stealth or by engaging in combat. It is best to take the snipers out with stealth either way. To take out the men on the floor with stealth, using yankable objects for distraction is effective to then pick them off; through combat, the usual mix of melee and web gadgets is effective.
Once the subway platform is cleared of thugs, to proceed, Spider-Man must yank the large subway car free and then head through following the yellow wire. This is another linear traversal section and then to the base of operations. Clearing out a few thugs here allows Spider-Man to then inspect the recordings left behind to learn about Project Olympus. Hearing three recordings and inspecting the blueprints unlocks the next segment, another linear traversal.
Reaching Silver Sable leads to a brief cutscene and then a battle commences, in which Silver Sable fights alongside Spider-Man. This is a longer battle against a group of Sable-armed thugs, where the usual battle tactics apply.
Once the battle is complete, a cutscene ends the mission. Peter will notice the presence of yellow tape nearby, starting the Mysterious Mystery mission. Afterwards, Citywide activities must be complete before Sable calls Spider-Man for the next mission, "One Plus One Equals Win".

Story:
Spider-Man helps calibrate Sable's class five laser array in her secret Sable International base, to prevent it overheating when used against Hammerhead. Hammerhead then arrives and battles them, The two work together, Spider-Man holding him in place for Sable's laser, but when her laser fails, she crashes her jet into him. This is enough to cause his Project Olympus suit to fail.
Spider-Man invites Sable to a pizza place, but she shuns him due to her war in Symkaria. She laments that she does not enjoy fighting but must to save her people. When Spider-Man calls her heroic for this, she shuns the label but shows gratitude to him for his help and drops him back at the city. In a post credits scene, Peter Parker teaches Miles Morales how to swing through New York.
Walkthrough:
The first section of the mission simply involves following Sable's orders. After yanking the objects she points to and completing the calibration on the towers around the base, Spider-Man must web throw barrels outside to test the laser. Finally, using the terminal leads to a cutscene and then into the final boss.
Hammerhead boss[]
The Hammerhead boss battle is a challenging endurance battle. Hammerhead himself uses attacks similar to his previous boss battle: leaping twice toward Spider-Man (requiring dodges to avoid them), and using a long range laser attack. Hammerhead also brings in several other thugs, which are a good source of building Focus.
The objective of the battle is to keep Hammerhead in place while Sable uses her laser. After she uses it, Spider-Man can then punch him repeatedly for damage until Sable can use her laser again. To get Hammerhead vulnerable to being held in place. Spider-Man must web him up with Web Shooters and punch his legs to keep him in place.
The fight comes in phases separated by cutscenes. After the first phase, Hammerhead begins using a shield, which prevents all of Spider-Man's web attacks. Sable's bombs can disable the shield, and Spider-Man must Web Throw them at Hammerhead when she performs a bombing run. In the meantime, Hammerhead will summon several thugs. Simply avoid Hammerhead until a Sable bomb can be thrown at him and once his shield is disabled, the usual tactics apply.
After dealing enough damage to Hammerhead, the final time holding him in place, Sable's laser will not fire. Continue holding him and a cutscene will take place, ending the mission and the DLC. Any activities not yet complete for the DLC can be done for all remaining trophies.
