Approach Belvedere Castle, and Spider-Man notices several of Wilson Fisk's men, all armed. Try to take them out stealthily using Perch Takedowns and Web Strike Takedowns, though if not possible, engage them in combat. After they are defeated, take a look at the laptop. As Spider-Man reaches for the device, a pigeon steals the thumb-drive.
Follow the waypoint to where the pigeons have flown. They will take off but leave a blue trail behind them as they fly. Get close enough to use  +  to catch one. If it does not have the drive, the chase continues until Spider-Man catches the correct one. Stopping travel and losing the pigeons will fail the mission.
After the drive is recovered, Spider-Man will need to return to the laptop. He will discover that Fisk's men were attempting to upload a computer worm to the Central Park WiFi system. Players will have three locations, and three minutes to arrive and stop the upload. Each location will have several men, some of which will have electronic tasers or a shield. As long as one of them is at the laptop, the countdown will continue. If one is knocked away from the laptop, another will take his place and the upload will continue.
Once the men are subdued, return to Stephanie, who has been spotted by Fisk's men. They have blocked her escape and are planning to kill her. Defeat the thugs and talk to Stephanie again to complete the mission, for a 1500 XP reward.

After arriving at the Detox center, find a good hidden location, preferably a perch atop a lamppost with a view of her face, and take the woman's picture. After this, she leaves in a vehicle and meets up with another person. Follow her and web to the ceiling above him to take his picture as well, then follow him as he takes the subway. The mysterious woman gives him the plans and Spider-Man sends his picture to Carmen who identifies him as Deshaun, a former friend of Rodrigo's from college who later went to prison on robbery charges.
The man will exit the subway and enter an office building. Climb up the outside of the building and spy on him and the man he meets. Take photos of the whiteboard and the screen for evidence, using windows that provide a clear view of each. After this, the two men leave the building and get into a vehicle. Follow it and a second vehicle.
Both vehicles will need to be stopped, and the easiest way to do this is by stopping the leading vehicle first. The second car will stop behind it and the driver can be easily defeated. Spider-Man will relay the information to Carmen, ending the mission.

Story:
Spider-Man finds a local business owner who thanks him for saving his daughter. Confused, Spider-Man looks to the crime scene to investigate, seeing a cop along with some beaten thugs. The owner's daughter, present at the scene, asks why he is still there and not off to stop the nearby fire. Spider-Man plays along and tracks the fire where the imposter had saved people, and upon investigating a fire extinguisher that the imposter used, identifies a substance on it as Ammonium Dihydrogen Phosphate, which can be used to track the imposter. Spider-Man concludes the imposter is clearly trying to do good, but by using his costume without his powers, is putting himself in great danger.
Spider-Man eventually finds the imposter accosted by Wilson Fisk's men, and rescues him. The two fight Fisk's men together, and the imposter reveals he is actually a local martial arts teacher teaching at Chikara Dojo, just trying to "spread the legend". Spider-Man convinces him to help out by going to the local F.E.A.S.T. shelter and offering free self-defense classes and instead leave the crime-fighting to the real Spider-Man.
Walkthrough:
After talking to the business owner, head to the theater, the first crime scene. The daughter is still at the location just in front of the entrance to the theater, as are the cop and the defeated but breathing thugs. Talking to the daughter reveals a Spider-Man imposter heading south to check out a fire. Examine everything at the scene then follow the next waypoint to the fire.
Puzzle solution.
Locate the fire scene and check for evidence and clues. Firemen, a civilian, and a fire escape can be examined. A fireman is looking for a fire extinguisher, which is located just to the right of the building entrance. Investigate it and solve the mystery of the unknown substance. The substance is identified as Ammonium Dihydrogen Phosphate, a fire suppressant. Spider-Man is able to use the chemical signature to track "Spider-Man 2.0".
The trail leads to a drug deal scene. Interact with the arrested thug at the end of the trail, then climb to the roof of the nearby building and examine the thugs and the drugs. After this, head to the edge of the roof, where Spider-Man finally catches up with the imposter, finding him held at gunpoint by some of Fisk's men. Jump down and rescue him, then defeat the thugs. The thugs arrive in two waves, and the imposter will help fight in melee combat, though Spider-Man will have to do most of the heavy lifting, particularly against thugs with firearms and rocket launchers.
Once the side mission is cleared, the location of the final battle becomes the location of a Fisk Hideout.

Story:
After finding all the mascots hidden by Black Cat, Spider-Man ran an algorithm to track her location, believing if he caught her first he could stop her from robbing.
Upon arriving at the hideout, he found several items, including financial data on the Maggia crime families, and art stolen from Wilson Fisk. He then discovered a recorded message left from Black Cat, in which she told him it was all a set-up. Once the Black Cat figurines were all together in the police evidence room, they hooked up and boosted their signal to deactivate the alarms to the police headquarters, allowing Black Cat to sneak in and retrieve her gear. Spider-Man realized she was planning something much bigger, as she had found $50,000,000 worth of loot just to retrieve her items.
Walkthrough:
Go to the old train depot and look for a hidden entrance found on the right side of the wall. Once inside, Spider-Man will notice several items on shelves and the walls created or confiscated by the Black Cat.
There are a few items that can be inspected, but the most important is the voice recorder message at the end of the room. Find it to complete the mission and collect the Dark Suit.

Beginning the mission unlocks several pigeon icons across the maps of each district around New York City. The mission can be accepted early on, allowing the player to find pigeons naturally while completing other tasks around the city.
Once Spider-Man is close to a pigeon location, the bird will take off and fly around the district, leaving a blue trail. Players will have to pursue the bird and try to get close enough to collect it. Grab the bird using  and . Each bird will reward the player with one Research Token and completing the mission will net the player 1000 XP XP.

Story:
Spider-Man talks to a woman at a rooftop who asks him about the "Screwball challenge", asking him to take a photo of a QR code. After doing so, Spider-Man calls him and welcomes her to the stream which she claims is surging in followers with his presence. Though Spider-Man is uninterested in participating in the challenge, she tells him that the challenge leads to a kidnapping victim, and thus he complies.
Throughout the challenge, Spider-Man is attacked by Screwball "fans", criminals who try to kill him, and has to disable several bombs placed atop rooftops also by her professed "fans". When he completes the challenge, the "victim" at the end is not a victim at all, but is in fact Screwball and more of her "followers". The police arrive once they are defeated to arrest Screwball, but as she points out, it was her fans who did the damage, not her.
Walkthrough:
This mission begins at night, so the time of day will change. The mission is begun by talking with a woman at the mission's starting location to begin Screwball's photography challenge. Spider-Man will need to locate and take photographs of matrix barcodes on walls throughout the city. Screwball herself is streaming the challenge and when Spider-Man considers backing out, she lets him know there is a kidnapped hostage's life at stake.
The first code is on the wall behind the woman. Photograph it to begin. Each code will provide the location of the following one, marking it on the map. The second code is just over 500m away but is too large to photograph from the ground. Spider-Man will require a higher perch to get a good view. Screwball will send some of her "followers" to pay Spider-Man a "visit", leading to a brief combat challenge. Defeat them to move on.
The third code will require some distance and maneuvering as it appears over two buildings. After the picture is taken, Screwball will challenge Spider-Man to stop three bombs from exploding on three different rooftops. There is no way to disable them, so fling them into the air and shoot them with webbing, causing them to explode safely.
The fourth location is not a code, but is the victim herself. Reaching it and beating the enemies here completes the mission.

The mission begins at Octavius Industries in Greenwich. Interacting with the transmitter in the lab will begin a puzzle to solve. An image of the solved connections is in the gallery below.
Once the transmitter is repaired, exit the laboratory. Spider-Man can track what it leads to. Use the radar on the left side of the screen to narrow down the location. It will eventually lead to a cargo truck. Intercept the truck and pull out the driver. Stop the truck and defeat the thugs exiting the truck, and any reinforcements. Open the back door of the truck to complete the mission. This will also unlock the next side mission, "Tombstone: What's He Building in There...".

Beginning at the mission area are several armed guards. Some can be taken down with sneak attacks if desired. The largest group of Tombstone's gang are near the front, unloading the truck. It might be easier to pick off others in the gang by stealth prior to engaging the larger group. Look for a few near lampposts, north of the main entrance. A few others are near shipping containers.
After guards are cleared out, take a look at the barrels the thugs were unloading. Spider-Man will comment about the chemicals. Right afterwards, another smaller group of thugs will attack. While under the influence of the mysterious chemical, they will be harder to defeat but the chemical does wear off over time. Players having trouble with the fight may want to wait for each one's skin to stop glowing before attacking them. There are also plenty of barrels, bikes, and other items to grab and toss at them which additionally helps to build up focus.
After all the gang members are defeated, return to the first drug-induced biker and grab his drug inhaler. This will start a science mini-game. This one is a little complex in that it takes multiple fragments used together to complete it. The solved puzzle is in the gallery below. The chemical is identified as Diox-3.
To combat the chemical, Spider-Man will need to craft a counter-drug. Look for lab supplies at the back of the truck. Creating the counter-drug will complete the mission and unlock the next, "Tombstone: Let's Get Ready to...".

The side mission is a boss battle with Tombstone. Tombstone can be attacked with melee moves and Finishers. After beating on Tombstone for a while, he will call in his thugs. They will need to be defeated, then Tombstone is weakened a bit more before the counter-drug can be used, which will happen automatically.
After the counter-drug takes effect, Tombstone will be more vulnerable to attacks. He will have a fire-covered metal hook on a long chain that he will swing at Spider-Man. Avoid the chain if possible and finish wearing Tombstone down to end the fight and complete the mission.

Head to the south end of the Financial District, near the water. Follow the waypoint to the location. Spider-Man will notice several masked thugs beating up students. Defeat them to complete the mission.

The image shows the elevated train tracks in East Harlem. As you head for the area, Phillip will mention Carlos from the previous missing student mission. Apparently Carlos got sick after the Halloween party – a delayed reaction.
When Spider-Man is close to the area, he will find witnesses to talk to. One will mention maniacs up the street. This leads to a battle against thugs with the same costumes as the ones from the Halloween party incident. Dispatch them and talk to Ethan to finish the mission.

The courthouse is the first of four sniper locations. Taking out the first sniper will unlock the rest and start a two minute, thirty second timer. This basically becomes a race around the city as the first three sniper take-downs themselves are fairly easy. The fourth involves a fight with three thugs. Running out of time will fail the mission.
The second half of this mission is a hostage rescue. The captured perpetrator revealed that there are several tourists being held hostage and that his cohorts in crime will execute them if the cops don't let him go. This part of the mission will test Spider-Man's ability to take out thugs quietly. If he is noticed, the hostages will die and the mission will fail.
Most of the thugs will be alone, but not all of them, so pick targets carefully and pick them off through stealth. Picking those off at the outer circle through stealth is easiest, and once no snipers are covering it, take the rest on the ground. Saving the hostages will end the mission.

Story:
A police officer expresses concern to Spider-Man that Wilson Fisk will be able to get out of jail due to the evidence being destroyed. A fan of J. Jonah Jameson's podcasts, he blames Spider-Man for the affair. As Spider-Man looks for the evidence, he bemoans that Jameson is so convincing.
Spider-Man uses an RFID tracking tag to find the cargo truck containing the evidence, and returns it to the officer. The officer is unfazed, finding it suspicious that Spider-Man knew where the evidence was. Spider-Man's spidey-sense then alerts him to an attack from a rocket launcher near the precinct as the Kingpin tries to attack it to destroy the evidence. When Spider-Man defeats them, the officer apologizes for listening to Jameson and thanks Spider-Man, but still asks if it is true if Spider-Man is an alien.
Walkthrough:
After talking to the officer, the radar will appear on the player's screen. Following the tracker to the first location, Spider-Man will notice a truck containing the evidence. In order to retrieve it, he will need to defeat several thugs, most of which are on the ground. One is on an upper level.
The thugs can be taken out through stealth or combat, though it may be easier to take out the snipers first with stealth either way. After taking the evidence, Spider-Man will need to return it to the precinct in Hell's Kitchen.
After returning to the original officer with the drives, Spider-Man's spider-sense alerts him to a nearby thug with a rocket launcher, who barely misses him and the officer. Take out the thug with the launcher, then head for the street in front of the precinct. The police will be under fire and there will be several thugs to defeat.
After defeating the men attacking the precinct, several more of Fisk's men have made it to the rooftop are beating up the original officer. Take them out and save the cop to complete the mission.
